releaseNotes:
## What this update addresses

- Adds privacy-preserving NAPLAN contribution export and Priority observations
  to the bundled NAPLAN Evidence Explorer.
- Publishes NAPLAN Network v1.0.0 as an optional download, separate from the
  Windows and macOS base applications.
- Adds network comparison, contextual ICSEA, filter-aware focus areas and
  personalised Word inquiry reporting.
- Advances MOSAIC to v2026.0.7 and NAPLAN Evidence Explorer to v2.1.4.

The base application remains fully functional when NAPLAN Network is not
installed.

- Corrects the macOS Evidence Explorer launch deadlock and preserves responsive Network window activation.
